body.message:
Before I send my passport or make any payment, please send me the booking agreement / registration card for review.
I need the agreement to clearly state:
Exact apartment/unit number in Bluewaters Residences Building 4
DTCM permit number
Rental period: October 3 to November 2
Monthly rental amount: AED 25,000 all-inclusive
Security deposit: AED 2,000
The exact legal status of the additional AED 25,000 payment
Written confirmation that if I do not extend for a second month, the full AED 25,000 will be refunded automatically, with no deductions or penalties
The deadline for notifying you that I will not extend
The exact deadline for returning the AED 25,000
Cancellation and refund conditions
Also, please confirm that I can come to your official Bay Square office to sign the agreement and make the payment there.
